MCA.title: HOD's Message
hodMessage: Dear MCA Students,

Welcome to the PG Department of Computer Applications. Our vision is to empower you with the latest technical knowledge and skills in the pursuit of shaping you as technology leader of tomorrow by equipping with the skills to excel.
Department fosters a culture of curiosity encouraging research and innovation by pushing you to explore, question and create.
As the technology realm demands leadership and teamwork along with technical proficiency, ecosystem at the college provides platform to these through appropriate teaching – learning practices.
Brace yourself for a transformative learning experience as we explore the boundless possibilities of the tech world together.
Wishing you an enriching and successful journey.

MOC.title: HOD's Message
hodMessage: Welcome to the Post Graduate Department of Commerce of Nagarjuna College of Management Studies, Chikkaballapur. Ever since the establishment of the department in the year 2018, the M.Com Program has recorded consistent improvement in its academic and research performance. Department has integrated industry relevant to bridge the rapidly changing industry expectations and other stakeholders. Department encourages students to get hands-on experience in the corporate world through internships and projects.

M.Com is a specialized area in itself and M.Com Program at NCMS has an exceptional record in both teaching and research areas. The department is proactively involved in organizing the academic events like student exchange programs, seminars, workshops; SDP’s providing a platform to develop the required skill set.
On behalf of the entire department, I take this opportunity to invite you to the Department and become a part of this transformational journey.

Science.title: HOD's Message
hodMessage: Welcome to the Department of B.Sc, We are delighted to have a dedicated team of highly qualified faculty members committed to shaping the future leaders in the fields of Physics, Mathematics, and Computer Science. Your journey with us promises to be an enlightening experience.
We go beyond academics by encouraging you to delve into the world of research and innovation. Our department fosters a culture of curiosity, pushing you to explore, question, and create.
Prepare for an exciting and enriching journey. Together, we’ll explore the limitless possibilities of the scientific world and work towards making a meaningful impact.
Wishing you a fantastic learning experience!

UG_CA.title: HOD's Message
hodMessage: Dear Students,

Welcome to the Department of Computer Applications. We take pride in having a team of highly qualified and motivated faculty members to mould the technological leaders of tomorrow. We are excited to have you embark on this educational journey with us.

Our primary goal is to equip you with the knowledge and skills needed in the ever-evolving tech industry. In a world where technology is the driving force of innovation and progress, our aim is to equip you with the knowledge, skills, and mindset to excel. As Computer Application students, you’ll be well-prepared to take on roles as problem solvers, project leaders, entrepreneurs, and, most importantly, as ethical citizens in our global society.

Furthermore, the institution provides a platform for you to enhance your employability skills through Industry-Institute Collaboration, offering real-world insights, and practical skills to enhance your employability
Get ready for an exciting and enriching journey, as we explore the boundless possibilities of the tech world and work towards making a meaningful impact.

UG_Commerce.title: HOD's Message
hodMessage: Dear Students,

Welcome to the Department of Commerce and Management. Our department has a rich legacy of academic excellence, and it is my privilege to lead a team of dedicated professionals, enthusiastic learners and committed team to shaping the Managers and Entrepreneurs of tomorrow, and we’re excited to have you embark on this educational journey with us.

Faculty members are committed to delivering quality education that combines theoretical insights with practical applications. We encourage an interactive and engaging learning environment that fosters critical thinking, problem-solving, and innovation, through workshops, seminars, and industry collaborations.

Our foremost goal is to equip the students with latest knowledge and skills necessary to navigate challenges of the dynamic global economy and a cultivate a culture of innovation and entrepreneurship, offering opportunities for the development of leadership and managerial skills that contribute to ethical and socially responsible citizens.
Our curriculum aims to develop a versatile skill set in functional areas enhancing employability through Industry-Institute Collaboration for practical insights and distinctive job market advantages.
Get ready for an exciting and enriching journey. Together, we’ll explore the boundless possibilities of the business world and work towards making a meaningful impact.
We continue on this journey with our Commitment to Excellence!

MBA.title: HOD's Message
hodMessage: In present globally competitive and highly challenging business environment, dynamic managers having vision, resourcefulness and proficiency to face the problems and challenges are in demand. Management institutions play a vital role in inculcating these skill sets required in business world.

NCMS’ culture of excellence and credentials allow students to gain an all-round learning experience. In association with Industry, NCMS is striving to provide Quality Management Education to create future leaders who shall manage powerful organizations in the emerging corporate landscapes. The state-of-art facilities, industrial collaborations, highly qualified and experienced faculty collectively makes NCMS the best choice for management courses. MBA Program at NCMS is designed to empower the next generation of well-rounded, agile-thinking and innovative individuals. Department of MBA has always ensured that every student must hone various skills and abilities which comprise of Public Speaking, Team Building, Interpersonal Skills, Presentations Skills, Time Management, and Business Etiquettes and so on, that eventually increase students’ career prospects. The curriculum is well supplemented with Student Development Activities to mould the young graduates into Management Professionals who excel both in personal and professional life with focus on the all-round development of students’ fraternity.

It has been rightly said “A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step”. As one day down the road you will look back at your career path and know that the small steps you took along the way are what set you up for success, so come and join us in the journey of aspiration. We continue on this journey with our Commitment to Excellence!
Wishing you all Good Luck
